property_summary: After a Collect call, the sum of balances across all addresses is at most the contract's total balance.
The balance of the caller after a successful Collect is unchanged when their balance equals MinSum.
After any sequence of operations ending with a Collect call that reverts for the caller, the contract's total balance is unchanged.
After a Collect call with the caller's balance exactly equal to MinSum, the caller's balance in the contract is unchanged.
A Collect call on behalf of a caller whose balance exactly equals MinSum should succeed (non-reverting) and reduce the caller's balance by the requested amount.
After a Collect call that reverts, the balance of the caller remains unchanged.
The balance of the caller after a successful Collect call is exactly the reduction equal to the amount withdrawn.
After a successful Collect call, the caller's unlockTime remains unchanged from before the call.
After a Collect call with a valid amount, the caller's balance decreases exactly by the withdrawn amount when the call succeeds.
The order of conditions in Collect does not affect whether Collect completes without revert when acc.balance >= MinSum and block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime and _am == 0.
After a Collect call with sufficient balance and lock time, the caller's balance decreases by exactly the collected amount.
After a Collect call succeeds (does not revert), the unlockTime of the caller remains unchanged.
When Collect reverts, the caller's unlockTime must be unchanged.
After Collect succeeds (returns true and does not revert), the caller's balance decreases by exactly the collected amount and the unlockTime remains unchanged.
After a successful call to Collect(uint256) that transfers ether, the sender's balance decreases by exactly the collected amount and the unlockTime remains unchanged.
After a call to Collect(uint256) with any amount, the sender's balance never decreases if the call succeeds, but may increase only due to a reentrant Put.
Collect() can only increase the sender's balance (via reentrant Put) when block.timestamp > unlockTime before the call, not when block.timestamp < unlockTime.
After an account collects funds, the new lock time is at least the old unlock time.
Collect can only decrease the sender's balance when block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime; otherwise it reverts or leaves balance unchanged.
Collect(uint256) can only decrease the caller's balance when block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime; otherwise balance stays unchanged or reverts.
After a Collect call, the user's balance should never increase
After Collect, the user's balance should not increase as a result of calling Collect
After a successful Collect call, the caller's balance in the Acc mapping should not increase.
After a successful Collect call, the logged amount in the last message should equal the amount subtracted from the caller's balance.
When a Collect call fails (reverts), the caller's balance in Acc should never increase.
